Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Boundary Modern Reclaimed Fir Wood Dining Kitchen Table, 66"L, Honey Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Wood
Reclaimed fir wood has been fashioned into a dining table that defines simple rustic beauty. Beautiful natural wood tones make your space warm and inviting, while sturdy construction will make this piece last through many game nights. 66"L x 38"D x 29.9"H Made of hardwood comprised of 100% reclaimed fir A simple, natural style that works with modern farmhouse décor A dining table that can double as a work or craft space Assembly in 15 minutes or less; just screw in legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
